en: The image shows an old postcard featuring the facade of a large church with classical architecture, including tall columns, decorative elements above the entrance, and a bell tower with a clock. There are groups of people in early 20th-century attire gathered in the square in front of the church. The sky is lightly colored, suggesting a hand-tinted or colorized photograph. The top of the postcard reads 'Arco - La Chiesa.'
